qualitative.gate_2_reason: Speculative gold price-taker with 100% of mining assets and revenue concentrated in South Africa, subject to severe infrastructure (Eskom power), labor unrest, and non-Western sovereign risks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Need). Speculative gold commodity price-taker with entire operating base in South Africa (Barberton, Evander, Elikhulu), exposing cash flows to Eskom load shedding, union labor disputes, and South African jurisdictional risk.
qualitative.evidence: Pan African Resources is a gold producer whose revenues depend entirely on the spot gold price. All physical operations are based in South Africa, where persistent power grid instability (Eskom load-shedding), deep-level mining cost inflation, and violent illicit mining ('zama-zamas') create severe operating hazards outside Western rule-of-law jurisdictions.
